name: walletfreak
description: Map trips, organize wallets by person, refresh portal balances and explore results locally.

interface.longDescription: Plan and import trips, map stays, compare costs and cards, and explore results in a private local travel dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Plan a trip with flexible dates and show my local trip board.
Open my personal wallet to enter my cards and loyalty balances.
Choose the best card or points redemption from my wallet using current quotes and offers.
Map my hotel stays and route in a compact itinerary.
Use wallet-sync to refresh one person’s rewards balances from their portals.
Turn my pasted booking confirmation into a reviewed itinerary.
